name: aem-orbit
description: Developer & author Chrome extension for AEM as a Cloud Service — publish (incl. Preview tier), reference check, content drift, JCR tree, component inspector, SEO/a11y check, command palette.

scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -f dist/aem-orbit-$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/extension && zip -qr ../aem-orbit-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' -x '*.map'
scripts.release: npm run check && npm run zip
